proof_summary: For the prime \(p=16843\), a blockwise modular computation gives \(\sum_{r=1}^{p-1}r^{-1}\equiv0\pmod{p^3}\); splitting \(H_{p^2-1}\) into terms divisible and not divisible by \(p\), and using \((ap+r)^{-1}\equiv r^{-1}-ap/r^2\pmod{p^2}\), shows that \(p^2\) divides the reduced numerator of \(H_{p^2-2}-1\). Hence for the composite \(n=p^2=283686649\), the relevant numerator-minus-denominator is divisible by \(n\), so the defining gcd equals \(n\).
